verdict.rationale: Stagehand's own docs let users choose whether browser state is retained. A user-data directory persists cookies and local storage across runs, Browserbase contexts persist session data, and region selection keeps session data in a required jurisdiction. Nothing documents deleting data, retention periods, or opting out of the server-side caching of act/observe/extract results. Missing for 10: documented deletion controls, configurable retention windows, a cache opt-out or purge, a data-retention policy, and independent corroboration.
